record.body:
## Description

Fix the spec-gap that blocked the phase review. One integration test must build the temporary repository, read the created record with open_store, run orchestra close-batch to exit 0, call the Python close on that same fixture, fail if that call starts aff or adaptive-artifacts, and fail unless that Python close accepts the fixture.

## Approach

Extend tests/test_library_e2e.py, the one integration test. Assert open_store sees the record adaptive-artifacts create wrote. Call close_batch.main on that fixture and assert it returns 0. Record subprocesses for that call and fail if any is aff or adaptive-artifacts. Do not discard bind failures. Do not add a second test file as a substitute.

payload.title: Make the integration test cover the close

record.subject: fix-library-e2e-coverage
